title: How was {event}? 4 minutes to shape the next one
description: A short feedback survey for people who attended {event}. Your answers decide what the {team} keeps, changes and drops next time.
audience: People who registered for {event}, in person or online
purpose: Decide what to keep, change and drop for the next edition of {event} (content, networking, venue or platform, schedule, communication)

welcome.title: How was {event}?
welcome.description:
Thanks for joining {event}. We're the {team} at {company}, and your answers decide what we keep and what we change for the next one. We'll share the highlights with everyone who took part.
• Takes about 4 minutes
• Anonymous: only the {team} sees answers, in summary
• Voluntary: you can stop at any time
• Open until {date}. Questions? {contact}

thank_you.title: Thank you, see you next time
thank_you.description: We'll email a summary of the feedback, and what we're changing for the next edition, within a month of {date}. Questions? {contact}

questions.label: How did you take part in {event}?

jumps.when: Q1 is 'I registered but didn''t attend'
